[color=#99ff99]Hard Light is an english speaking 18+ medium roleplay server[/color]

• Admins will instead be held accountable through use of the Admin code of conduct.
[color=#ffff00]If you have any questions about these rules, please use the Admin help menu by hitting F1 in-game, or clicking the "AHelp" button in the lobby, or alternatively, ask for assistance on the discord.[/color]
[head=3]Definitions[/head]
Please refer to https://docs.hardlight.space/rules/mrp for the Roleplay Expectations guidelines. The rules below stand on their own and are enforceable as written.
[color=#00fffb]Powergaming[/color] Taking unreasonable steps to eliminate failure states or vulnerabilities, at the cost of believability.
[color=#00fffb]Min-maxing[/color] A form of powergaming: combining gear, chemicals, genetics, or constructions to reach an advantage the mechanics were not designed to produce, or taking "best in slot" gear across multiple slots to eliminate risk.
[color=#00fffb]Validhunting[/color] Seeking out, chasing, or attacking a threat on the basis of player knowledge that the target is an antagonist, rather than in-character motivation.
[color=#00fffb]Metagaming[/color] Acting on information your character does not have.
[color=#00fffb]Greentext[/color] Mechanical completion of objectives. Greentext records an outcome and carries no weight in evaluating roleplay.
[color=#00fffb]Self-antagging[/color] Engaging in antagonistic actions against other players or the station, usually but not always criminal offenses, while not an antagonist role. - Antagonist roles are those such as (but not limited to): Traitor, Xenoborg, Thief.
[head=3][color=#ff0000]Rules marked in Hardlight's [color=#00fffb]color[/color] will be enforced at all times. Other rules will only be enforced upon recieving a user report.[/head][/color]

[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 1: Behavior Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]1.1[/color] [color=#00fffb]Be respectful to others OOC. [/color]
[color=#a4885c]1.2[/color] Don't use hate speech, racism, or bigoted comments.
[color=#a4885c]1.3[/color] [color=#00fffb]Don't metagame.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]1.4[/color] Don't spam or advertise.
[color=#a4885c]1.5[/color][color=#00fffb] Do not intentionally take actions that would negatively impact or disrupt others' enjoyment of the game. [/color]
[color=#a4885c]1.6[/color] Avoid controversial topics such as self harm/rape in public.
[color=#a4885c]1.7[/color][color=#00fffb]Don't evade bans. [/color]
[color=#a4885c]1.8[/color] Don't self-antag.
[color=#a4885c]1.9[/color][color=#00fffb] Don't ragequit/disconnect to avoid consequences. [/color]
[color=#a4885c]1.10[/color][color=#00fffb] Making use of cheats, exploits, or taking actions that may harm the server's integrity or stability is forbidden. [/color]
[color=#a4885c]1.11[/color][color=#00fffb] Respect others' OOC consent and preferences. [/color]
[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 2: Game Server Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]2.1[/color] [color=#00fffb]If you are banned from a role or department, you may not play that role. This includes seeking or accepting promotions into roles you are banned from or taking Ghost roles which hold the role in question. [/color]
[color=#a4885c]2.2[/color] Do not make yourself a major problem, annoyance, or disruption for the crew while not being an antagonist (i.e. self-antagging).
[color=#a4885c]2.3[/color] [color=#00fffb]It is strictly forbidden to livestream rounds to others or share recorded gameplay outside of Hardlight without consent of all parties involved. [/color]
[color=#a4885c]2.4[/color] Ghosting with with the sole intent of spying on others' personal activities is not permitted.
[color=#a4885c]2.5[/color] [color=#00fffb]Any vandalism, theft, or major disturbance on ColComm is not permitted. You are also not to trespass within the central CC offices.[/color]
[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 3: Metagaming Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]3.1[/color] Use the chat channels for their intended purposes.
[color=#a4885c]3.2[/color] Characters do not retain any knowledge of what happened while they were dead.
[color=#a4885c]3.3[/color] Do not use any information gained by meta-communication.
[color=#a4885c]3.4[/color] [color=#00fffb]Discussion about the current round is allowed on the Hardlight Discord server. HOWEVER, acting on information gained through this method is considered metagaming. [/color]
[color=#a4885c]3.5[/color] Do not meta-grudge or meta-friend. (Using in or out-of-character information to give unfair treatment or advantages to others.)
[color=#a4885c]3.6[/color] [color=#00fffb]Do NOT antag-roll. (Intentionally ghosting or cryoing to look for antag roles.)[/color]
[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 4: New-Life Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]4.1[/color] Players maintain all in-character memory up until going critical provided they do not die.
[color=#a4885c]4.2[/color] If a player is brought back to life after death, they cannot recall how they died. this means they will not know the killer, or be able to utilize meta information about their death.
[color=#a4885c]4.3[/color][color=#00fffb] If a player respawns as the same character they cannot remember anything that happened in the previous life, equipment/owned items may be recovered, but otherwise they forget everything.[/color]
[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 5: Naming Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]5.1[/color] Don't make meta references.
Try to be creative by picking a believable and fitting name and/or surname.
Leeway is given to theatrical roles such as the clown, boxer, and mime; these roles are allowed stage names with some amount of freedom.
[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 6: Roleplay Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]6.1[/color] Your character is a separate entity from you, the player. Your character's actions, feelings, and knowledge in-game should be based solely on the character's experiences rather than your own as the player.
[color=#a4885c]6.2[/color] Do not play excessively hostile or provocative characters. Playing a character accurately should never result in rulebreaks. - Ahelp for any questions relating to this.
[color=#a4885c]6.3[/color] If you choose a job on shift, you are required to participate in the round as said job when necessary.
[color=#a4885c]6.4[/color] Do not intentionally break roleplay to gain an unfair advantage while someone is typing.
[color=#a4885c]6.5[/color][color=#00fffb] Respect other people's consent, dignity and boundaries. IF SOMEBODY ASKS YOU TO STOP BOTHERING THEM LOOC (local-out-of-character), do so. If this rule is abused, Ahelp right away. [/color]
[color=#a4885c]6.6[/color] Do not dismantle key portions of station infrastructure (IE. escape pods.)
[color=#a4885c]6.7[/color][color=#00fffb]Roleplaying an underage character is strictly forbidden. So is talk of such activities. [/color]
[color=#a4885c]6.8[/color] [color=#00fffb]Roleplay Standard[/color]
This is a Medium Roleplay server. Your character must be played as a believable person. Play them in a way that generates roleplay opportunities. Please refer to https://docs.hardlight.space/rules/mrp for the Roleplay Expectations guidelines this standard is built on.
Competence, efficiency, planning, and stealth are permitted.
Winning or completing mechanical objectives (greentext) does not justify low-effort, disruptive, or non-roleplay behavior. Antagonist objectives exist to drive stories and do not grant immunity. Players are expected to handle conflict gracefully and do the least harm necessary.
Actions should make sense from the perspective of your character, not simply an optimal strategy for you as a player.
- Acceptable: Playing as the Chief Engineer one round, and the Chief Medical Officer the next - role expectations exist for the specific round only. - Acceptable: Failing an objective because you prioritized character interaction. - Acceptable: Killing a target quietly and efficiently, where your character had reason to do so and other players had some means of noticing, investigating, or responding. - Prohibited: Structuring a round so that no other player has an opportunity to respond - eliminating a target with no buildup and then destroying the body or evidence specifically to foreclose any investigation, or killing every witness to avoid in-character consequence. - Prohibited: Justifying disruptive or low-effort play with "I had to, it was my objective."
[color=#a4885c]6.8.1[/color] [color=#00fffb]Reaction to Consequences[/color]
Your character continues to exist after the round's events. Do not resist or evade authorities in a way disproportionate to the offense committed.
Security who witnesses disruptive conduct that begins as in-character actions but leads to evasion beyond reasonable means should seek Colonial Command intervention via fax or ahelp.
Admin guidelines will include steps to take - such as bluespace EMP or other creative measures to bring offenders to justice.
[color=#a4885c]6.9[/color] [color=#00fffb]Respect Round Start[/color]
For the first thirty (30) minutes of a shift, undertake preparatory actions only. Purchase equipment, construct, position, gather information, engage in social play.
Prohibited during this window: - Breaking into secured departments. (With the exception of non-antagonists genuinely interested in station success, such as a Freelancer powering on the AME - understanding potential IC consequences.) - Theft of secured or high-value objectives. - Objective aligned attacks/killings. - Destruction of station infrastructure.
This window only exists for round-start antagonists such as thieves, traitors, and nuclear operatives. Its purpose is so that personnel can respond to activity realistically.
[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 7: Powergaming Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]7.1[/color] Do not hide Antag objective items.
[color=#a4885c]7.2[/color][color=#00fffb] Do not make active use of known bugs in the game.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]7.3[/color] [color=#00fffb]Do Not Powergame[/color]
Game mechanics exist to support roleplay. Do not take unreasonable steps to eliminate every failure and vulnerability at the cost of believability.
Utilize game mechanics as they were intended to be used, in a manner that is believable to their application. Do not combine them in unbelievable ways.
[color=#a4885c]7.3.1[/color] [color=#00fffb]Equipment Restrictions[/color]
Do not take best-in-slot gear for every available slot.
Keep your loadout proportionate to your role, the current alert level, and the situation currently in progress.
Do not equip or utilize gear, chemicals, implants, or genetic modifications that your character has no logical, in-character reason to possess. Use of equipment must be plausible for your character and job role, regardless of what the game mechanics allow.
Do not treat hypothetical future danger as in-character justification. Equip in response to threats that have occurred or been announced.
- Acceptable: A salvager acquiring EVA gear, or an engineer obtaining radiation protection required for their work. - Acceptable: A paramedic carrying a sidearm or less-lethal, and the tools of their trade. - Prohibited: A non-security role equipping a combat loadout in anticipation of an alert that has not been called. - Prohibited: The Head of Security walking around in a heavy tacsuit on green.
[color=#a4885c]7.4[/color] [color=#00fffb]Do Not Validhunt[/color]
Do not seek out, chase, or attack a threat without a valid in-character reason. Attacking an entity solely because you know as a player that it is an antagonist is not acceptable.
Handling station threats is Security's responsibility. Non-security roles should only arm themselves or intervene if the situation reaches them in-character: a direct threat to themselves or their colleagues, an active distress call, a bounty, a Code Black, or an explicit request.
- Acceptable: A dragon carries off your colleague in front of you. Your character publicly vows to rescue or avenge them and spends the round pursuing that goal. - Acceptable: Defending a direct imminent threat to yourself or another person. - Prohibited: A research assistant arming themselves to hunt down a dragon they have no prior connection to.
[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 8: End-of-Round (EOR) Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]8.1[/color] End-of-round-griefing (EORG) is not allowed under any circumstance. This includes but is not limited to: fighting, explosives, chemicals, destruction of property, or any other disruptive behavior. End-Of-Round is defined as any time after it has been chosen for the evac shuttle to not be recalled.
[color=#a4885c]8.2[/color] Arrivals, as well as the Evac shuttle (and evac hallway), are considered Safezones in which this rule takes effect.
[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 9: Erotic-Role-Play (ERP) Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]9.1[/color] ERP does not take priority over your job. If you are requested or needed, you must respond or return to your duties ASAP.
[color=#a4885c]9.2[/color] DO NOT use ERP as bait for kill objectives, unless done with OOC consent of all parties involved. After the ERP is complete, a grace period of 5 minutes is in effect, during which you are still NOT allowed to kill the target.
[color=#a4885c]9.3[/color] Do not kinkshame.
[color=#a4885c]9.4[/color] You MUST use the (-) subtle command for any and all erotic roleplay material.
[color=#a4885c]9.5[/color] Do not spam or pollute radio channels (including the telepath channel) with NSFW topics. Mind you, this does NOT mean that you are not allowed to speak or discuss such. There should not be a cringy spamfest of: shitposting, hornyposting, or depression posting.
[color=#a4885c]9.6[/color] Do not engage in, nor discuss, ‘extreme’ sexual fetishes in public. Public includes: any radio channel (including the telepath channel), out loud speech or overt actions in actual public physical locations, or doing so on camera.
[color=#a4885c]9.7[/color][color=#00fffb] Engaging in ERP with a non-sentient creature is prohibited. The creature must be player-controlled; consent in OOC, and pass the Harkness test in-character. [/color]
[color=#a4885c]9.8[/color][color=#00fffb] When roleplaying another person's character, OOC consent from the original (the owner of said character) is required before you engage in ERP. [/color]
[color=#a4885c]9.9[/color][color=#00fffb] Be very mindful of in-character and out-of-character consent. If your (out-of-character) OOC consent is not respected, immediately Ahelp or open a ticket. [/color]
[color=#a4885c]9.10[/color] Extreme acts like snuff, abuse, noncon, and other extreme kinks are only allowed if all parties consented OOC, Ahelp if you need clarification (Keep it private).
[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 10: Command and Security Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]10.1[/color] Security and Command roles are expected to know and perform their jobs to the best of their ability. You will be held to a higher standard in these roles.
[color=#a4885c]10.2[/color] Both Security and Command are required to Know Space Law, Standard Operating Procedures, Alert Procedure, and Company Policy.
[color=#a4885c]10.3[/color] Don't abuse your position of power.
[color=#a4885c]10.4[/color] You are expected to roleplay with others. This includes antagonists.
[color=#a4885c]10.5[/color] If you're in Command, inform your department and Command before cryoing or disconnecting.
[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 11: Antagonist Guidelines[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]11.1[/color] Antagonists are held to a higher standard, similar to Command.
[color=#a4885c]11.2[/color] Antagonists are expected to roleplay with others. This includes Security and Command.
[color=#a4885c]11.3[/color] The damage that an antagonist is allowed to cause must be proportional to their objectives.
[color=#a4885c]11.4[/color] Ghost roles have their own independent rules that must be followed.
[color=#a4885c]11.5[/color] [color=#00fffb]Any antagonistic activity must cease on ColComm.[/color]
[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 12: Escalation Guidelines[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]12.1[/color] Lethal force against players should be a last resort.
[color=#a4885c]12.2[/color] Don't disproportionately escalate in response to others' actions.
[color=#a4885c]12.3[/color] Don't ignore critical or dead players unless related to an objective.
[color=#a4885c]12.4[/color] Don't intentionally round remove other players unless related to an objective.
[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 13: Ship saving[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]13.1[/color] Ships are to be no larger than 80x50 tiles.
[color=#a4885c]13.2[/color] Do not abuse the ship save mechanic to avoid in-character consequences.
[color=#a4885c]13.3[/color] [color=#00fffb]Do not exploit the stash to duplicate items. This especially goes for contraband.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]13.4[/color] [color=#00fffb]Do not use inventories to circumvent stash restrictions.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]13.5[/color] Ship saving backups are only to be used in the event of ship destruction or loss due to a server crash or other unforseen issue. Loading backups otherwise is only to be done with admin permission.
[color=#a4885c]13.6[/color] [color=#00fffb]Do not under any circumstances modify a ship save file without admin permission (like with the engine update).[/color]
[color=#a4885c]13.7[/color] [color=#00fffb]Do not go afk for extended periods on your ship (like logging off to sleep). The ship saving is provided to allow people to save progress without the need to do this. UNATTENDED SHIPS WILL BE REMOVED.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]13.8[/color] [color=#00fffb]DO NOT ADD MORE THAN ONE BLUESPACE STASH PER SHIP.[/color]
[color=#ffff00][head=3]Shipbuilding Guidelines[/head][/color]
Examples of these guidelines can be found on the official Hardlight wiki (https://docs.hardlight.space/ship-building-guidelines)
[color=#a4885c]13.9[/color] [color=#00fffb]The larger the ship, the more docking ports it must have. It is your responsibility to find a way to minimize your docking impact as best as possible, as to avoid one ship taking up the entirety of 3 docks. For those seeking to build larger ships, you are strongly encouraged to build a public throughway to aid in ease of docking.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]13.10[/color] [color=#00fffb]Atmos tanks are limited to no larger than 40 tiles. Be it a 10x4 tank or some other configuration, the maximum tile count is a hard 40 per tank. Only one tank per gas type per ship. All atmospheric tanks must be hard-walled or glassed in. They may not be run by directional fans. No sub-framing to contain more gas than the space should normally hold.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]13.11[/color] [color=#00fffb]Emitter shields are not to be used as ship shields - that is what actual ship shields are for. The only time emitter shields should be on a ship is to contain a tesla power source.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]13.12[/color] [color=#00fffb]Ships are not to be enclosed with Directional Fans. Those are allowed for external access points or specialty rooms only, such as:
Docking points
Thruster access points
Salvage bays
Any other point that has intended external access
Cold rooms
Artifact chambers
This means putting them under doors/blastdoors/airlocks/docking points is fine if they are for external access or the other mentioned use cases. All walls should be clear of Directional Fans - enclosing your ship in them will be considered Power Gaming and will be removed and noted.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]13.13[/color] [color=#00fffb]Your ship cannot be a square or rectangle in shape. Its IFF signature must be unique and at least somewhat geometrically broken up in some fashion. No flying space bricks or tubes. Break up your ship's shape to at least some degree to make it uniquely identifiable at a glance.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]13.14[/color] [color=#00fffb]All armored hulls are to be no thicker than 3 layers deep. Noses of ships have a small amount of leeway here for aesthetic purposes.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]13.15[/color] [color=#00fffb]All thrusters must be exposed to space, guarded only by grilles. Chuted thrusters may be set back no deeper than 5 tiles into a chute, with no more than 3 full tiles of grilles in front of them. An additional Half-Grille may be added if it makes sense for aesthetic purposes. Angled chutes are fine so long as they abide by the depth rule, and are guarded by a hard limit of no more than 3 grilles. Thrusters cannot be stacked in chutes. Each chute should contain a single thruster only - small, medium, or large. Nacelles can be made, so long as the thrusters can still be shot at and are only covered by grilles.[/color]
